item.title: UMD Softball Picked to Finish 4th in NSIC Conference, Williams & Jenkins Named Players to Watch
item.description: DULUTH, Minn.- The UMD softball team has been picked to finish 4th in the NSIC conference. That’s according to the coaches preseason poll. Additionally, catcher/infielder Kendal Jenkins has been named a player to watch and Allyssa Williams has been named a pitcher to watch. UMD’s first game is January 30th against Eastern New Mexico. item.title: Proctor/Hermantown Defender Taylee Manion Wins Gold with U.S. U-18 National Team
item.description: HERMANTOWN, Minn.- It was a successful trip to Nova Scotia for current Proctor/Hermantown defender Taylee Manion.
